task.claim:
Let A be the free associative Z-algebra on the generators t_1, ..., t_B and
v, and let rho be the evaluation homomorphism from A onto the group algebra
Z[Aff(G)] induced by sending t_i to the translation X |-> X + s_i P and v to
the negation X |-> -X of the cyclic group G of order n.

Then the kernel of rho is NOT generated, as a two-sided ideal, by the
commutators xy - yx alone.

Witness: v^2 - 1 lies in the kernel of rho, because negation is an
involution of G. But v^2 - 1 does not lie in the two-sided ideal generated
by all commutators: the quotient of A by that ideal is the commutative
polynomial ring Z[t_1, ..., t_B, v], and the image of v^2 - 1 there is the
nonzero polynomial v^2 - 1.

The same argument applies to (v * t_i)^2 - 1 for each i. This torsion is
forced by negation having order 2, and is not optional bookkeeping.
